title: Expected distribution
view: Shared back-view base (visuals/distribution_bases/back): skeleton on the left, grey body on the right, seen from behind so the patient's right is on the image RIGHT; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A thoracic erector spinae plane block numbs the posterior hemithorax over several levels, with graded edges.
claims: Skin: the posterior hemithorax from about T2 to T9, midline to the flank (record anatomy: spread cranio-caudally and into the paravertebral space), graded lower border.
Bone: the right ribs below and medial to the scapula (intercostal spread; the scapula is not supplied by the thoracic nerves and is left grey).
Right-sided block (patient's right on the image right in this back view); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
